title: KQML-Liver: Interpretable Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Liver Disease Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.15241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. translated_title: KQML-Liver：基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的可解释混合量子机器学习用于肝脏疾病分类
translated_abstract: 肝脏疾病仍然是全球主要的健康问题，凸显了对可靠且易于获取的早期检测方法的需求。尽管机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习的最新进展已经引入了有前景的诊断工具，但许多方法存在可解释性有限的问题，并且由于数据泄漏或过于简单的评估方案而导致性能虚高。这些限制降低了它们在真实临床实践中的可靠性。本文提出了KQML-Liver，这是一个将量子机器学习与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）相结合的混合框架，旨在提升预测性能和可解释性。该架构将用于表达性特征表示的参数化量子电路与基于KAN的函数映射相结合，以可解释的方式捕捉非线性关系。该框架在印度肝病患者数据集（ILPD）上，通过防止数据泄漏的严格预处理方案进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出KQML-Liver混合框架，将量子机器学习与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络结合，在防止数据泄漏的严格评估协议下实现了可解释且可靠的肝脏疾病分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework integrating quantum machine learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks to achieve interpretable and reliable liver disease classification under rigorous evaluation protocols that prevent data leakage.
